glosses: cell (the basic unit of a living organism)
cell (a small group of people forming part of a larger organization)

examples.text: Las células sanguíneas son producidas en la médula ósea.
examples.en: Blood cells are made in the bone marrow.

examples.text: El porcentaje de carbohidratos en las célula animal es de aproximadamente el seis por ciento.
examples.en: The percentage of carbohydrates in animal cells is approximately 6 percent.
